levels.surface: أحمد بن أبي عبد الله البرقي

notes: «يرفعه إلى» is a gap (rule 8): unnamed, between صفوان بن يحيى and the Imam.

«أبي عبد الله» is named inside the chain after «إلى»: kept as a narrator, not imam_in_text (owner ruling 2 concerns the Imam named only in the words after the chain); the saying («قال إبليس») is his report.
«رضي الله عنه» and «عليه السلام» are blessings, left out; «[أشياء]» in the matn is an editor's bracket.
